_comment: Every number that tunes the game: chances, timers, payouts, caps, costs. Read through Balance (Balance.f/i/a with a 'section.name' key). `v` is the value; `note` says what it is and where it came from. Change numbers here, never in code; tools/balance_lint.py checks every key is used and every use has a key, and tools/balance_sim.tscn shows what a change does.

fuel_tank.note: Fuel the tank holds when full.

fuel_regen_seconds.note: the tank slowly refills: 1 fuel every 10 minutes

fuel_tank_gem_cost.note: Gems to refill the tank at once.

tractor_coin_chance.note: coins pop out of the ground while a vehicle plows

tractor_coins.note: Coins in one pop-out while a vehicle plows (see tractor_coin_chance).

fuel_find_chance.note: FarmVille: plowing your own farm can turn up fuel, once a day

mystery_box_gem_cost.note: Gems to buy a Mystery Box.

material_gems.note: gems for one building material (FarmVille: 1 Farm Cash each)

limit_vehicle.note: one of each, wherever it is: standing on the farm or parked in a Garage

limit_decor.note: How many of one decoration a farm may hold (effectively unlimited).

limit_living.note: animals, trees, blooms and the like

default_limit.note: buildings of one kind a farm may have, for now

bunch_days.note: a placed Perfect Bunch lasts 14 days

fast_crop_seconds.note: A crop that grows in less than this counts as fast for mastery targets (6 hours).

stray_min_gap.note: a new stray turns up 3 to 6 hours after the last

stray_max_gap.note: The longest wait, in seconds, before a new stray turns up after the last (6 hours).

stray_stays.note: a stray nobody adopts wanders off after a day

lost_weight.note: each lost animal's share of the stray pool (a 100-coin animal is 1.0)

bushel_chance.note: a harvest drops a bushel of its crop, once you own a crafting building

bushel_cap.note: bushels held at once (FarmVille's stall held 100)

stall_crops.note: the Farmers Market offers this many crops a day

stall_each.note: 3 bushels of each, like 3 a day from each neighbour in FarmVille

craft_xp_per_star.note: XP for a craft, per star of the recipe.

lamb_chance.note: Sheep Pen harvest with a ram inside

piglet_chance.note: Pig Pen harvest with a boar inside

calf_chance.note: Dairy Farm harvest with a bull inside

fertilizer_chance.note: Dairy Farm harvest drops a bag of fertilizer

foal_chance.note: Horse Stable harvest with a stallion inside

stable_helper_chance.note: Stable harvest: a farmhand, and separately an arborist

stable_xp_chance.note: Stable harvest with a stallion: 100 XP

stable_xp.note: XP prize from a Horse Stable harvest with a stallion (see stable_xp_chance).

nursery_spare_xp.note: stands in for FarmVille's spare baby to gift a friend

perfect_bunch_chance.note: FarmVille: a flower harvest can give a Perfect Bunch

bunch_cap_no_shed.note: bunches kept without a Garden Shed

shed_free_bunches.note: FarmVille gave 10 bunches with the shed

daily_parts.note: Building parts in the daily gift.

slop_cost.note: Coins for a bucket of slop at the Pig Pen.

forage_seconds.note: How long pigs forage for truffles (8 hours).

pigs_per_truffle.note: Pigs needed in the pen for it to find truffles.

truffles_per_pig.note: Truffles a pig can find in one forage.

queen_gem_cost.note: Gems to buy a Queen Bee.

bee_chance.note: per flower harvest, only into a hive with a queen

pollination_per_bee.note: Pollination chance each bee adds (1 in 400).

max_pollination.note: The most the pollination chance can reach.

pollinated_lifetime.note: How long a pollinated plot stays pollinated (2 days).

bees_stay_days.note: away longer than this, bees start to leave

bees_leave_per_day.note: Share of a hive's bees that leave for each day away beyond bees_stay_days.

queen_stays_days.note: Away longer than this many days, a hive loses its queen.

seedling_share.note: An Orchard harvest gives a Mystery Seedling this often (otherwise a Watering Can).

rare_chance.note: a seedling from a tree with a rare variety grows into the rare one

mystery_baby_chance.note: per animal home harvest (our guess: FarmVille's pens varied)

home_feed_chance.note: an animal home's harvest leaves a sack of Animal Feed

nursery_feed.note: the Nursery Barn's harvest: FarmVille's nursery gave feed daily

bulb_chance.note: per Single Bloom harvest (doubled for a Full Bloom)

bloom_food_chance.note: a bloom's harvest leaves Flower Food

regrow_food.note: Flower Food to regrow a withered Single Bloom

golden_pity.note: guaranteed after this many harvests without one

collectible_chance.note: one item from the crop's collection

collectible_pity.note: Harvests without a collectible after which one is guaranteed.

bird_chance.note: a bird visits: one item from the bird collection

mastery_luck_bonus.note: per mastery star, multiplies golden and collectible chances

rescue_coins.note: Coins given to a player with nothing left to plant.

golden_coin_multiplier.note: A golden harvest pays this many times the coins.

golden_xp.note: Extra XP on a golden harvest.

fertilizer_cost.note: Coins for a bag of fertilizer.

bonus_xp.note: Extra XP on a bonus-XP harvest.

start_unwithers.note: Unwithers a new farm starts with.

pollinated_ripe_mult.note: pollinated crops stay ripe twice as long

collectible_action_chance.note: Chance per plow, plant or fertilize of finding a collectible.

animal_collectible_chance.note: collecting animals, trees and buildings (barnyard and orchard sets)

unwither_gem_cost.note: Gems for an Unwither when none are left.

fresh_farm_clear_seconds.note: a new farm starts in fair weather for this long

start_coins.note: Coins a new farm starts with.

start_gems.note: Gems a new farm starts with.

xp_per_level_after_table.note: XP per level beyond the level table.

mastery_price_bonus.note: a crop's price, per mastery star (MasterySystem has the stars)

level_xp.note: Total XP needed to reach level n is entry n-1. Tuned with tools/balance_sim: level 20 in about two weeks at three visits a day.

sell_markup.note: A crafted good sells for its ingredients times this.

fuel_base.note: Fuel a craft is worth, before stars.

fuel_per_star.note: Fuel added per star of the recipe.

sell_share.note: FarmVille sold anything back for 5% of its price

sell_coins_per_gem.note: our guess for items bought with gems

min_xp.note: The least XP buying a priced decoration gives.

min_ripe_window.note: A ripe crop stays ripe at least this long (4 hours).

max_ripe_window.note: A ripe crop stays ripe at most this long (2 days).

wither_after.note: a Single Bloom left ready this long withers (FarmVille: 7 days)

block_seconds.note: One weather per block of this many seconds (3 hours).

ease_seconds.note: A block's weather fades in and out over this long at its edges.

correlation_blocks.note: How long weather persists: neighbouring blocks are alike within about this many blocks (4 = 12 hours). 1 is the old coin-flip-per-block; higher is steadier.

fog_hours.note: Fog only forms when a block begins in these local hours (early morning).

odds.note: Share of time each kind of weather is out, by season (weights). Fog only in the early morning; snow only in winter. Looks only: FarmVille had no weather.

enabled.note: 1 layout synergies on (our own touch, not FarmVille 2009), 0 off: touching homes of one kind pay no extra

home_boosts.note: 1 stocked homes boost the farm (data/home_boosts.json; our own touch), 0 off

enabled.note: 1 feeding on (our own touch, not FarmVille 2009), 0 off: no feed drops, no hunger, no effects

chance_base.note: chance a harvest of a feedable crop family drops one feed (estimate)

chance_per_star.note: more chance per mastery star on the crop

tree_chance.note: chance collecting a tree gives one Fruit

stock_cap.note: most of one feed the Barn holds

cap_per_barn_level.note: more of each feed per Barn upgrade level

overflow_coins.note: coins for a feed that finds the Barn full

animals_per_feed.note: animals one unit of feed feeds in a home

accepted_share.note: an accepted (not favourite) feed gives this share of the effect

rich_bonus.note: a Rich feed (from a golden, super or pollinated harvest) adds this share to the effect

hunger_penalty.note: share of the coins an unfed animal's collect loses (never all)

produce_bonus.note: extra coins on the next collect, from a favourite feed chosen for produce

speed_bonus.note: share of the cycle cut off, from a favourite feed chosen for speed

rare_multiplier.note: times the chance of a rare find, from a favourite feed chosen for rare
